London, 1861. A mother hangs the most fashionable colour in England in her baby's nursery. It is, slowly and in writing, going to kill her children. But first — doesn't it look lovely?

Carl Wilhelm Scheele, who discovered this colour, also tasted most of his own discoveries. This will not surprise you in a moment.

Okay so. A penguin walks into a job interview. No wait, this is a true story and it's somehow worse. Stay with me.
